label: [LOCAL-MECHANISM-PROTOTYPE · NOT EVIDENCE · NOT E2/E3 · single self-authored pass stack, NOT two product pages conflated into one proven shader pipeline]
scope: A small SELF-CREATED luminance field with EXPLICIT exposure and halo/grain toggles, at most FOUR output variants. This is a candidate local post-processing mechanism, NOT the ascii-magic / backgrounds.supply real kernel or a proven internal shader pipeline / pass order. The two product pages' feature labels are NOT merged into one claimed pipeline here.

color_units.input: 8-bit grayscale code value 0..255 (self-created luminance field, NOT sRGB-encoded photography)
color_units.internal: float luminance in 0..255 code-value units; exposure is a multiplicative gain on this value
color_units.output: 8-bit grayscale code value 0..255, CLAMPED at 0 and 255 (clipping recorded per variant)
color_units.note: Deliberately declared as raw code values (no EOTF / no CIE L* here) to keep the operator simple and MEASURABLE. This is NOT the METRIC-PILOT sRGB->L* scale; that scale is used only in the enigmatriz prototype. Do not mix the two scales.
color_units.random_state: coordinate-deterministic pattern: grain(x,y) = ((x*73 + y*151 + x*y*7) % 41) - 20, NO random module, NO global seed. This is a LOCAL deterministic pattern, NOT a website seed.

bright_region.description: known bright-region mask = axis-aligned rectangle (the 'halo source')

halo_region.description: ring AROUND bright region where halo effect is measured (outside bright rect, within expanded rect)

flat_region.description: a flat mid-luminance patch used for high-frequency (grain) measurement

exposure.description: multiply every luminance code value by gain, then clamp to 0..255

halo.description: add a blurred bright-region contribution to the halo ring: for each halo-region pixel, add gain * mean(bright-region value) * falloff(distance to bright rect); a LOCAL box-mean approximation, deterministic

grain.description: add coordinate-deterministic signed noise amplitude to every pixel (then clamp)

variants_at_most_four.description: self-created luminance field, no operator applied
halo toggle only (exposure off to isolate)
grain toggle only (exposure off to isolate)

difference_maps: For each variant v1..v3, emit a PNG difference map |variant - baseline| (clamped 0..255) and a JSON diff stats: mean absolute diff overall, in bright region, in halo region, in flat region, plus clipping counts (px at 0 / px at 255).
intended_checks_before_run: C1 exactly 4 variants (<=4) emitted, each 64x48 grayscale, dimensions UNCHANGED across all variants
C2 exposure variant: regional mean luminance rises; clipping count >0 (gain 1.35 on bright=250 -> 255 clip recorded); declared color units (0..255 code values) stated
C3 halo variant: halo-region mean luminance INCREASES relative to baseline while bright-region and far-field means stay ~unchanged (halo is localized); difference map shows energy in the halo ring
C4 grain variant: flat-region high-frequency difference (mean |diff| in flat patch) > 0 and overall low-frequency structure preserved (grain is high-frequency, deterministic)
C5 all variants + difference maps + raw arrays/config retained; coordinate-deterministic (no RNG), identical on rerun
C6 deterministic rerun: full second generation; per-file sha256 identical
C7 BOUNDARY: single self-authored pass stack; do NOT conflate two product pages; do NOT claim time continuity / website determinism / 4K / video export / real internal shader pipeline
